description: The figure contains two side-by-side vertical bar charts illustrating Fleiss’ Kappa values across different category settings, with each bar annotated by its numeric value. In both panels, the vertical axis is the value axis labeled “Fleiss Kappa,” shown on a linear scale starting at 0 and extending to just under 1, with regularly spaced tick marks at approximately 0.2 intervals (0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8). In the left panel, the horizontal axis contains four numeric category labels (0.0, 0.47, 0.82, 0.94) in left-to-right order; the bars are colored in shades of blue and have heights labeled 0.88 at 0.0 (darkest blue), 0.46 at 0.47 (medium blue), 0.03 at 0.82 (light blue, near the baseline), and 0.24 at 0.94 (light-to-medium blue). In the right panel, the horizontal axis is labeled “Max Ambiguity” and contains three categories labeled 1, 2, and 3 in left-to-right order; the corresponding blue bars are annotated 0.89 for 1 (darkest blue), 0.46 for 2 (medium blue), and 0.23 for 3 (lighter blue). No legend is shown, the bars are not stacked or grouped within categories, and there is no visible sorting beyond the left-to-right order of the x-axis labels; the primary visual emphasis comes from the large numeric annotations above each bar.
